about.text: Mizithra or myzithra is a Greek whey cheese or mixed milk-whey cheese from sheep or goats, or both. It is sold both as a fresh cheese, similar to Italian ricotta, and as a salt-dried grating cheese, similar to Italian ricotta salata. The ratio of milk to whey is usually 7 to 3.

how.text: The Wikipedia page gives the mix as milk 7 parts to whey 3, which is why Mizithra reads as a whey-and-milk cheese rather than whey alone. Temperatures, salt amounts and ageing times are not given in it.
